description: Land Acquisition - Bokundara, Kesbewa D/S Division, Colombo District
categorisation: This gazette content is a Land Acquisition Notice published under the Land Acquisition Act. It specifically declares that certain lands are needed for a public purpose and will be acquired, providing detailed descriptions of the land parcels including their locations, extents, and boundaries. The content focuses entirely on land matters (acquisition for public purpose) and does not involve government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or any of the other specialized categories.
